notes:
Asking about a caption or logo that's already burned in gets a straight answer.

'make the logo bigger' used to plan a full re-render of your whole video. 'make the captions smaller' and 'make the watermark bigger' offered to add a NEW one on top. Meanwhile 'make the subtitles smaller' — the same request, one word different — correctly explained that a burned-in overlay is part of the picture.

They all give that explanation now, and point you back to the original clip.
